textbookBox.concept: A healthy body depends on organ systems working in harmony—skeletal, muscular, respiratory, and circulatory systems.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: A healthy body depends on organ systems working in harmony—skeletal, muscular, respiratory, and circulatory systems.
beats.speakEn: A healthy body depends on organ systems working in harmony—skeletal, muscular, respiratory, and circulatory systems.

beats.en: Muscles are made of elongated muscle fibres. Voluntary muscles (limbs, neck) move by our will, while involuntary muscles line internal organs and cardiac muscle forms the heart.
beats.speakEn: Muscles are made of elongated muscle fibres. Voluntary muscles (limbs, neck) move by our will, while involuntary muscles line internal organs and cardiac muscle forms the heart.

textbookBox.concept: Regular physical activity strengthens muscles, protects bones and joints from injury and arthritis, improves posture, and increases muscle oxygen use.

beats.en: Regular physical activity strengthens muscles, protects bones and joints from injury and arthritis, improves posture, and increases muscle oxygen use.
beats.speakEn: Regular physical activity strengthens muscles, protects bones and joints from injury and arthritis, improves posture, and increases muscle oxygen use.

beats.en: During exercise, respiratory rate rises and an 'oxygen debt' can occur when oxygen demand briefly exceeds intake; regular training increases vital capacity up to 5500 cc.
